inspiration: Leaping parasite: a small crawler solves its jump speed from the height gap and gravity, then scales its sideways speed so it lands on the target height at the top of the arc (dlls/headcrab.cpp:236-244). Hits only while airborne (dlls/headcrab.cpp:356) and clears its contact after one hit (dlls/headcrab.cpp:363). Keep the solved arc and the single airborne hit; make the body plan our own.

Defect to fix, keep the idea: the distance cap scales the whole jump vector including the vertical part (dlls/headcrab.cpp:251), so the arc no longer lands on the target height. Fix: cap only the sideways part, or lengthen the flight time to match.
Idle hop with no target: with no enemy the crawler does a short forward hop (dlls/headcrab.cpp:256), a cheap idle beat.
Idle chatter in combat: a low random chance each think to make a small sound while in the combat state (dlls/headcrab.cpp:371). Life in the fight without new animation.

Ceiling or floor ambush plant: a fixed creature extends a tongue, pulls prey up at a fixed step per think (dlls/barnacle.cpp:184), then runs a kill timer. Defect: the file defines a kill delay (dlls/barnacle.cpp:27) and the code sets a different one (dlls/barnacle.cpp:196). Fix: one data field read by both.

Named schedule vocabulary: about 42 SCHED_ states (dlls/schedule.h:34-45 region) covering idle, alert, flinch, investigate-sound, combat and a fail state. A short named set that posture alone can read.
Fail fallback: when every schedule fails the crawler tries to jump (dlls/headcrab.cpp:542). Unpredictability at no asset cost.

briefs.label: Leaping parasite
briefs.why: a low fast hop telegraphed by the arc itself; the hit only counts on the way down
briefs.keep: solved arc to the target height; airborne-only hit; one contact then off
briefs.change: different body plan (not a crab); a crouch tell before the leap; a glow at the peak

briefs.label: Ceiling ambush plant
briefs.why: a fixed trap that reads from far away and pulls prey up over several seconds
briefs.keep: fixed position; steady pull per think; one kill timer that ends the pull
briefs.change: vine or root look; a bloom cue as it pulls; a clear silhouette for the lifted target

briefs.label: Named schedule set
briefs.why: a small set of states the player reads from posture alone
briefs.keep: idle, alert, flinch, investigate-sound, combat, fail
briefs.change: our own state names and combat states written for our attacker cap

briefs.label: Combat chatter
briefs.why: a rare random sound keeps a fight feeling alive
briefs.keep: low chance per think while in combat
briefs.change: our own vocal set per creature type
